metadata.note: Synthetic demo series generated by scripts/make_kilima_demo_artifacts.py --synthetic-donor: a rain-reset soiling model over public Open-Meteo precipitation for this fictional site. Not measurements. Costs are estimates; update with actual values.

recommendations: Clean in the dry seasons (January to February, June to September); the long rains in March to May and the short rains in October to December recover most of the deposit for free.
INV-03 fouls about 2.5x faster than the fleet median; inspect its row for a local dust source before the next fleet cleaning.
